replies.Is it better to commit small changes oft: Yes, small, frequent commits are usually better. They're easier to review, simpler to revert, and make it clearer when something broke.

replies.Why do builds get slower over time?: Usually because the project keeps growing, with more files, dependencies, and tests to process. Stale caches, unnecessary rebuilds, and bloated dependency trees add to it.

replies.What's a good way to start the morning?: Try a glass of water, a few minutes of daylight, and one small task you can finish before checking messages. It sets a calm tone for the rest of the day.
replies.And a good way to end the day?: Write down three things you finished today and one thing to do first tomorrow. Then put the screen away for a bit before bed.
replies.What about the middle of the day?: Take a real break around lunch, away from your screen, even for ten minutes. Then tackle the hardest task while your focus is still fresh.
